contexts.text: The Lord's life from birth to childhood. Treated of.
The Lord's first perception (while) He was as yet a child. Treated of.
That Jehovah appeared to the Lord while He was as yet a child. Signification.
The Lord knew this when a child, and thought thus...
The knowledge... which the Lord learned when a child. Signification.
Such power had the Lord when a child, and by it... subjugated the most direful Hells... Representation.
With those who, from childhood, begin to be inflamed with the desire to exercise dominion through the holy things of the Church, the spiritual mind is completely closed...
